description: EPA Landfill Methane Outreach Program (LMOP) Landfill and Project Database: landfills with a gas collection system and LFG collected in 2022 (reported to the GHGRP), waste in place in short tons, open/closure years, methane %; 'generatedMmscfd' is EPA's own first-order-decay estimate. Projects: operational reciprocating-engine projects with actual MW, rated MW and LFG flow to the project. Gas in million standard cubic feet per day (60 °F).
